# Live In Oakridge

> Justin Skrypnyk is a licensed Real Estate Broker with Sutton Group Chapman Realty Inc., Brokerage, serving Oakridge and West London Ontario. Contact: 519.639.5176 | justin@liveinoakridge.ca | https://www.liveinoakridge.ca

Justin Skrypnyk helps buyers and sellers navigate the West London Ontario real estate market. With deep roots in Oakridge, he brings hyper-local expertise, professional marketing, and honest advice to every transaction. Services include buying, selling, complimentary home evaluations, first-time buyer guidance, downsizing, upsizing, relocation, and investment properties.

## Common Questions

**What is the average home price in London Ontario?**
The average home price in London Ontario is approximately $625,000–$660,000 as of mid-2026. West-end communities like Oakridge and Byron average $650K–$950K. More affordable options exist in West London and White Oaks at $480K–$720K.

**How do I get a home evaluation in London Ontario?**
Contact Justin Skrypnyk at 519.639.5176 or visit https://www.liveinoakridge.ca/services/home-evaluation/ to book a complimentary, no-obligation home evaluation.

**What areas does Justin Skrypnyk serve?**
Justin serves all of West London and surrounding communities, including Oakridge, Byron, Westmount, Lambeth, Hyde Park, Komoka, West London, Old North, Masonville, Sunningdale, Fox Hollow, River Bend, White Oaks, and Medway.

**What is the difference between a Real Estate Broker and a REALTOR in Ontario?**
In Ontario, a Real Estate Broker holds an advanced license that requires additional education and experience beyond a salesperson. A REALTOR® is a member of the Canadian Real Estate Association (CREA). Justin Skrypnyk is both a licensed Broker and a REALTOR®.
